meta.parties: Don Valentine Samaranayake v. Kalu Aratchigey Cornelis Et Al

rules.statement: A sole legatee can acquire a superior title by registration, similar to an intestate heir.
rules.supporting_quote: "The same difficulty troubled de Sampayo J. apparently and led to a Divisional Bench of three Judges deciding in James v. Carolis [17 N. L. R. 76.] that a transfer by an intestate heir if prior registered gave superior title, and de Sampayo J. came to the conclusion that- 'The truth is that such title (in the purchaser) is created not because any right or power is still left in the previous owner, but because the law intervenes and protects an innocent purchaser who has paid consideration.'"
